description: Create a Sequence - Create a new email sequence/campaign. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience (e.g. their own opt-in or otherwise consented contacts) — never addresses assembled by the model — and suppression/blocklist is always enforced. Sequences are created paused by default; launching (resuming) sends emails to recipients and must only happen after explicit user confirmation.

bcc.description: BCC email address for all outgoing emails

checkEmailBeforeSending.description: Verify email before sending. When enabled user must approve email before they can be sent

checkEmailClick.description: Check if recipient clicked a link in previous email

checkEmailOpen.description: Check if recipient opened previous email

checkEmailReply.description: Check if recipient replied to previous email

confirm.description: Required when paused is false — confirms the account holder explicitly approved launching the sequence

emailSendingHours.description: Custom email sending hours for each day of the week (Monday-Sunday). Default: weekdays 09:00-17:00 enabled, weekends disabled.

enabled.description: Whether sending is enabled on this day

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the sequence. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder).

invalidEmail.description: Send to contacts with invalid email status

launchTimingMode.description: When to launch: 'now' (default, starts in ~5 mins) or 'schedule'

lists.description: Array of list UUIDs to include in the sequence

paused.description: Whether to create the sequence in paused state. Default true (the API pauses new sequences when omitted). When false, the sequence launches and starts sending emails (in ~5 mins with launchTimingMode 'now', or at scheduledAt when 'schedule') and requires confirm: true as the account holder's explicit approval.

riskyEmail.description: Send to contacts with risky email status

scheduledAt.description: Launch time. UTC milliseconds OR an ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. '2026-07-08T16:30:00+05:30' for 4:30 PM IST. Required when launchTimingMode='schedule'.

steps.description: Sequence steps. Required and non-empty. Each email step must be {type: 'email', template_id: 'public-template-uuid'} with optional send_as: 'new' | 'followup' (followup replies in the existing thread; ignored on the first email step, which always starts a new thread). Each delay step must be {type: 'delay', days: number}.

send_as.description: How to send this email: 'new' (default) starts a new thread; 'followup' replies in the lead's existing thread as 'Re: <original subject>'. Ignored on the first email step of the sequence, which always starts a new thread.

template_id.description: Public template UUID for the email step

days.description: Number of days to wait before the next step

stopWhenReplyRecievedWhen.description: When to stop sequence on reply: 'contact' = stop for this contact only, 'contact-with-same-domain' = stop for all contacts sharing the same domain

timezone.description: IANA timezone for scheduled sending, e.g. 'Asia/Calcutta' or 'America/New_York'. Required when launchTimingMode='schedule'; otherwise it defaults to America/New_York.

validEmail.description: Send to contacts with valid email status

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: create_sequence

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Create Sequence
